svg.title: Portal content authorization gates
svg.desc: The embedding guide provides a complete text walkthrough of this flow.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Connected-site content write
Save, preview, or publish

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Tenant and source found?
Admin or tenant member

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Platform admin
or tenant editor / owner?

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Admin, billing disabled,
or billing allows editing?

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Check requested action
Content permissions and values
Draft revision + source head

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Return action-specific error
Resolve fields or revision conflict

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Store Postgres draft
Public site does not change

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Commit to explicit target branch
Client workflow deploys site output

div.style: color: rgb(23, 43, 53) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Portal confirms successful run
for that content commit
